INTERMEDIATE ARCHITECTURAL & INTERIOR DESIGNER
Location: New York, NY
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 4–6 Years
Salary Range: $75,000–$95,000 annually
About the Position
ATELIER ARMBRUSTER is looking for a creative, detail-oriented Intermediate Architectural & Interior Designer to join our collaborative New York City studio.
We are seeking someone with a strong design sensibility, a passion for architecture and interiors, and an appreciation for materials, craftsmanship, and thoughtful detailing.
Working closely with the Principal and Project Manager, the ideal candidate will contribute to all stages of our projects, from early design concepts and space planning to technical documentation, FF&E selections, and construction administration.
This position is ideal for a designer who enjoys both the creative and technical sides of the profession, brings fresh ideas to the table, and takes pride in transforming thoughtful design concepts into beautifully executed spaces.
Key Responsibilities
Architecture & Interior Design
- Collaborate with the Principal and Project Manager throughout the design process, from concept development through project completion.
- Contribute creative ideas and thoughtful design solutions that reflect each project's character and vision.
- Develop space plans, furniture layouts, interior elevations, sections, architectural details, and design presentations.
- Explore and research materials, finishes, colors, textures, and architectural elements.
- Assist in designing custom millwork, cabinetry, built-in furniture, and other architectural features.
- Prepare mood boards, material palettes, sketches, 3D models, and visual presentations to communicate design concepts.
- Participate in design reviews and contribute to the refinement of architectural and interior design solutions.
Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment (FF&E)
- Assist with the selection and specification of furniture, decorative lighting, textiles, rugs, window treatments, and accessories.
- Research products, materials, and furnishings from showrooms, manufacturers, and vendors.
- Prepare and maintain FF&E schedules, specifications, and presentation materials.
- Coordinate with vendors and showrooms to obtain samples, quotations, product information, and lead times.
- Support the development of custom furniture and decorative elements, working with fabricators and artisans as needed.
- Assist with FF&E procurement coordination, including tracking orders, deliveries, and installations.
- Help ensure that furniture, materials, and decorative selections are thoughtfully integrated into the overall architectural and interior design vision.
Technical Documentation & Project Coordination
- Prepare accurate architectural drawings, construction documents, interior elevations, sections, and detailed drawings.
- Develop and coordinate drawing packages under the direction of the Project Manager.
- Coordinate design information and documentation with consultants, contractors, and vendors.
- Assist in reviewing shop drawings, material samples, and product submittals for consistency with the design intent.
- Apply knowledge of building systems, construction methods, materials, and applicable building codes.
- Organize project files, drawings, specifications, and design documentation in accordance with studio standards.
- Manage assigned tasks and deliverables while maintaining accuracy and meeting project deadlines.
Construction Administration & Site Coordination
- Participate in site visits to observe construction progress and the implementation of design details.
- Document site conditions, prepare field reports, and assist with meeting minutes.
- Coordinate with contractors and fabricators to address design and construction-related questions.
- Assist in reviewing installations, finishes, millwork, and FF&E for consistency with approved designs.
- Support the preparation and follow-up of punch lists and project closeout activities.
Qualifications
Required
- Professional degree in Architecture, Interior Design, or a related field.
- 4–6 years of relevant professional experience in an architecture or interior design studio, preferably focused on high-end residential projects.
- Strong design sensibility and an appreciation for proportion, materials, craftsmanship, and detailing.
- Experience developing architectural or interior design drawings, including construction documentation and detailed elevations.
- Familiarity with interior design development, material selections, furniture layouts, and FF&E specifications.
- Proficiency in AutoCAD.
- Working knowledge of SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace.
- Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
- Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating with a multidisciplinary design team.
- Attention to detail, initiative, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
Preferred
- Experience working on high-end residential renovations and custom interiors in New York City.
- Knowledge of NYC construction practices, building codes, and consultant coordination.
- Experience with custom millwork, furniture detailing, and material specifications.
- Familiarity with FF&E procurement processes, vendor coordination, and installation.
- Experience with 3D rendering and visualization software, such as Enscape or similar programs.
- Experience participating in construction administration and site visits.
What We're Looking For
Beyond technical skills and experience, we value designers who are curious, creative, resourceful, and genuinely passionate about their work.
The ideal candidate is someone who:
- Enjoys exploring ideas, materials, and details that bring character to a space.
- Is comfortable moving between creative design work and technical documentation.
- Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities and follows through with care and attention.
- Communicates clearly and enjoys working in a collaborative studio environment.
- Is organized, adaptable, and comfortable contributing to multiple projects at different stages.
- Is eager to continue learning and developing professionally.
Application Requirements
Interested candidates should submit:
- A current résumé.
- A portfolio demonstrating architectural and/or interior design experience, including examples of design development, technical drawings, and completed or ongoing projects.
- Examples of FF&E selections, custom furniture, millwork, or material presentations, where available.
Please include a brief introduction describing your professional background and interest in joining ATELIER ARMBRUSTER.
About ATELIER ARMBRUSTER
At ATELIER ARMBRUSTER, we believe great design comes from collaboration, creativity, and careful attention to detail.
Our work brings architecture and interior design together through a thoughtful approach to space, materials, craftsmanship, and the relationship between function and aesthetics.
We value a collaborative studio environment where ideas are shared, creativity is encouraged, and every team member contributes to the design process.
